notes.title: Update 1.0 - Launch
notes.content:
Greetings, players!

We are officially releasing Rhythm Race, with massive bugfixes and refinements.

We made changes to performance and input feedback. Hope you like it!

notes.title: Update 0.4 RELEASED!
notes.content:
Greetings players! 

We from Bluefront received good feedback and let us be extremely happy to bring new content as soon as possible. 

It’s with great pleasure that we would like to introduce to our players our first new update for Rhythm Race featuring bug fixes and new content. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37790939/12a873160852f25c14721de5f4f7bd7daff2131f.png[/img]

We are introducing new 5 tracks available to play in all difficulties (Easy, Normal, Hard). 
[list]
[*][b]No Way Back[/b]
[*][b]Heavy Riff[/b]
[*][b]Heavy Riff 120bpm[/b]
[*][b]Action Dynamic[/b]
[*][b]Rhythm of Life[/b]
[/list]

The colors of the corner of track now reproduce the color that the player was selected to give to the player's best perception about what color the player has chosen. 

We made an update of the tutorial HUD.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37790939/8432d43957a17ee49f163676ff20f4476e9bec84.png[/img]

The following bugs have been fixed in the following songs. 

[b]Husky Frog[/b]
[list]
[*] Cars travel without colliding with others anymore.
[/list]

[b]Rhythmic Clapping[/b]
[list]
[*] Cars travel without colliding with others anymore.
[*] Finish lines don't pass through corners.
[*] Track from easy and normal difficulties are the same.
[/list]

[b]Stiffing Flow[/b]
[list]
[*] Cars travel without colliding with others anymore.
[/list]

[b]Radical Ressonance[/b]
[list]
[*] Cars travel without colliding with others anymore.
[/list]

[b]Severe Stone[/b]
[list]
[*] Normal difficulty is fixed. 
[*] Cars track from easy and normal difficulties are corrected. 
[/list]

[b]Let’s Rock[/b]
[list]
[*] Cars travel without colliding with others anymore.
[/list]

Also, it’s knowledge the fact it’s been almost two months since the release of the game without either any new content or communication between our social media about development log and features. We from Bluefront want to apologize to our players for that delay and this lack of communication about the dev of our game.  We’d want to create games where our players can bring an immersive experience. We are rookies and we hope to have a chance to give our best. We appreciate the feedback and we’d hope you like the new content. 

We also wish a Merry Christimas and a Happy New Year to our players.

Thank you for playing! See you next year!

notes.title: Rhythm Race v.0.3.4 Released
notes.content:
Hey players,

We just released version 0.3.4 of the Rhythm Race demo.

I would like to thank the players who sent their feedback, and we are improving the game according to your opinion. We are close to officially launching the game for early access!

[h2]Patch Notes[/h2]
[list]FEATURES
[*]Added a slider for sound effects.
[/list]
[list]BUGS AND FIXES
[*]Corrected rhythm of the three songs of the demo version.
[*]Correction in the menu music.
[*]Cars speed regulated.
[*]Bug when saving the latest sound settings.
[*]Bug of the error effect drop more than once per error.
[/list]

Enjoy!
